title: Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice 2026: The Peninsula Hong Kong named best hotel in the world
why: Recognition readers like to celebrate, spanning Asia, Paris and the Riviera.

body_long:
The Peninsula Hong Kong has been voted the best hotel in the world in the 2026 Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards. This is the 39th edition of the awards, decided by readers, with close to 800,000 votes cast across hotels, resorts, spas, trains and airlines.

## The world's top hotels

Behind The Peninsula Hong Kong, the top five is completed by Passalacqua on Lake Como, Park Hyatt Chicago, Le Méridien Essex Chicago and The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto. Cheval Blanc Saint-Tropez is the first French hotel in the world ranking, in 10th place, followed by Hôtel Barrière Le Majestic in Cannes in 12th.

Among resorts, Cheval Blanc Seychelles takes first place worldwide, ahead of Porto Zante Villas & Spa in Greece and Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, in Bali.

## France and the Riviera

In Paris, readers placed the Ritz Paris first, followed by Cheval Blanc Paris and Hôtel de Crillon, A Rosewood Hotel. Shangri-La Paris, Hôtel Plaza Athénée and La Réserve Paris also feature, with Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme, Fouquet's Paris, Le Royal Monceau Raffles Paris and Four Seasons Hotel George V completing the city ranking.

In the South of France and Monaco category, Cheval Blanc Saint-Tropez leads, ahead of Hôtel Barrière Le Majestic Cannes and Airelles Saint-Tropez, Pan Deï Palais. Grand-Hôtel du Cap-Ferrat, A Four Seasons Hotel, and The Carlton Cannes, a Regent Hotel, are also listed.

Elsewhere in France, Hôtel Barrière L'Hermitage in La Baule tops the ranking, followed by Auberge du Jeu de Paume in Chantilly and Hôtel Barrière Le Normandy in Deauville.

## Spas, trains and airlines

Six Senses Douro Valley in Portugal is voted the best spa in the world, with Grand Resort Bad Ragaz in Switzerland in fourth place. The Venice Simplon-Orient-Express is the readers' favourite train journey, and Qatar Airways leads the airline ranking ahead of Singapore Airlines.

## The signal

Readers' awards measure something different from expert guides: they reward the hotels guests remember and recommend. Two results stand out for our audience. LVMH's Cheval Blanc brand places a property at the top of two categories, in Saint-Tropez and in the Seychelles, and Barrière has three hotels in the French rankings. For a hotel team, a readers' award is a direct verdict on service.

Congratulations to The Peninsula Hong Kong and to every team recognised this year.
